main_text.p: ejus delicti nomine prætor introduxit, quæ appellatur vi bonorum raptorum: Et est intra annum quadrupli, post annum simpli. in princ. inst. cod.
main_text.head: Quando competit Actio?
main_text.p: Si dolo malo quis rapuerit. Nam qui aliquo errore ductus, rem suam esse existimans, & imprudens juris, eo animo rapuerit, quasi domino liceat etiam per vim rem suam auferre à possessoribus, absolvi debet. §. ita tamen inst. cod.
main_text.head: Quid Divalibus Constitutionibus prospectum est?
main_text.p: Ut nemini liceat vi rapere vel rem mobilem, vel se moventem, licet suam eandem rem existimet: sed si quis contra statuta principum fecerit, rei quidem suæ dominio cadat: sin autem aliena res sit, post restitutionem ejus, etiam æstimationem ejusdem rei præstet. §. ita tamen. inst. cod.
main_text.head: QUIS EST TERTIUS Titulus?
De Lege Aquilia. Vom Gesetz Aquilia.
Quid constituitur per legem Aquiliam?

p.i: Damni injuriæ actio constituitur per legem Aquiliam: cujus primo capite cautum est, ut si quis alienum hominem, alienámve quadrupedem, quæ pecudum numero sit, injuria occiderit: quanti ea res in eo anno plurimi fuerit, tantum domino dare damnetur. in princ. inst. cod.

main_text.head: Quis intelligitur injuria occidere?
main_text.p: Injuria occidere intelligitur, qui nullo jure occidit. Itaq; qui latronem insidiatorem occiderit, non tenetur, utiq; si aliter periculum effugere nō potest. §. injuria autem. inst. cod.

page.notes: The first line of the running head is "IURIS." in spaced capitals. The heading "QUIS EST TERTIUS Titulus?" is set in large italic capitals with a Black-letter-like flourish; the word "Titulus" is italic. "Vom Gesetz Aquilia." is set in Black letter (Fraktur) and is transcribed here in plain text. The Black-letter words are "Vom Gesetz" and the Fraktur "Aquilia" line; the exact Fraktur letterforms are uncertain. The paragraph "Damni injuriæ..." is set in a larger initial D (joined to "Damni"). Some letters in the scan are blurred, notably "Divalibus", "rapere", "æstimationem" and the marginal reference line "M 4"; these should be checked against the original. The "M 4" at the foot is treated as the signature. Show-through and a stray mark near the bottom were ignored.
